raw.headline: Prioritize Usability: it carries the largest complaint volume and severity among the four in-scope areas
raw.memo_markdown:
## Recommendation
Put next quarter's main product effort into Usability. Across the four in-scope areas it has the most complaints ({{C051}} complaints, {{C052}} severity points, mean severity {{C053}}, share {{C054}}). Its lead issue is the homescreen and player layout problem `usability/ui_layout` (baseline rank {{C015}}, complaint count {{C011}}). Ads and general usability complaints (`usability/ads`, `usability/general`) sit in the same area.

## Evidence
The single highest-ranked issue overall is `billing/subscription_entitlement` (rank {{C005}}, priority score {{C004}}). It is about basic playback controls being locked behind premium. It is a real and severe theme, but it is one issue with {{C001}} complaints, and the billing/support area as a whole totals {{C059}} complaints and {{C060}} severity points. Reviewers describe the layout update as hard to use, for example `e16a4550-43e7-4ae1-b538-a65cc652c31b` and `94c9f2f9-36fa-4c11-936e-660514fe7a35`. Ad load is raised in `e5e6c55f-3069-4b7c-9807-f8b5d5bf2726` and `c2738a4f-e57c-46bc-a4ad-8ec5a4b5d5cd`.

## Alternatives considered
Playback: {{C063}} complaints, {{C064}} severity points, mean severity {{C065}}. Most of this comes from `playback/general` ({{C026}} complaints), so the area is smaller and concentrated in one issue. Access: only {{C067}} complaints ({{C068}} severity points), with mean severity {{C069}} driven by `access/account_recovery` at rank {{C050}}. It is serious for affected users but narrow. Billing/support: {{C059}} complaints and mean severity {{C061}}. Its top issue is the strongest single signal, which is why a targeted entitlement review is listed below. Outside the four areas: {{C055}} complaints and {{C056}} severity points, but much of it is vague feedback in `other/general` (rank {{C010}}) or catalog items such as lyrics and recommendations, which are not clearly actionable product areas.

## Limitations
Reviews are self-selected public app-store text. Cancellation language reflects stated intent, not observed churn, and the {{C074}} cancellation-intent records are not churn measurements. No revenue, churn, or causal effect is estimated here. Completed records total {{C071}}, and {{C072}} are complaint or cancellation records. Unresolved, pending, or quarantined records number {{C073}}, so no records were excluded for that reason. Severity values are used as saved, and mean severity is a summary, not a measure of impact.

recommendations.rationale: This is the highest-ranked Usability issue, with complaints clustered around the recent update and the player layout.
recommendations.title: Fix the homescreen and player layout regression
